description: Chance entries that decide whether a PvE extra mission is offered after a run, selected by point-count tag and point-sum band.

Id.simple: Lottery row id, whose name encodes solo/tag mode.
Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_PvEExtraMissionLottery. GamePvE_RollExtraMission converts it to a string and tests whether it contains the tag PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_LOTTERY_SOLO (one point) or PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_LOTTERY_TAG (two points with a 100). Rows without the matching tag are skipped; the id is therefore used as a mode filter, not only as a key.

Id_GlobalThreshold.simple: Point-sum band in which this chance applies.
Id_GlobalThreshold.technical: FName, default None. The consumer resolves a FGameDataTableRow_GlobalThreshold from GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300); when missing, the row is skipped. The sum of the extra-mission Points array must lie within [Min, Max] with inclusive bounds for the Probability roll to happen.

Probability.simple: Percentage chance of drawing the extra mission.
Probability.technical: int32, constructor default 0. When the tag and threshold band match, the consumer calls GameManager.RollChance(0, Probability, 100); a true result sets bDrawn and stops iterating rows. Exported values include 0, 10, 25, 50 and higher, so the value is a whole-percent numerator over 100 rather than a float probability.

notes: The exported asset has 14 rows with FGameDataTableRow_PvEExtraMissionLottery; the manager loads PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTable into PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x930).
Only two point configurations can draw: one point uses the SOLO tag, two points use the TAG tag only when one value is 100. Any other count returns false without touching the table.
The reconstructed source's substring test uses Row->Id.ToString().Contains(Tag); this documentation does not assume case-insensitive matching beyond what the code shows.
The consumer is reconstructed at retail RVA 0x1311fb0 and called from 0x13cebd0; status/functions.json should be consulted for byte status. Content is partial.

usages.detail: GamePvE_RollExtraMission selects the solo/tag tag from the extra-mission point list.
Iterates all lottery rows, filters by id tag, threshold band and Probability roll.
